headline: Large order wins; new products to drive growth

highlights: During H1FY27company secured order inflows of ₹2,036 crore including the landmark ₹1,844 crore Uttam AAU radar order from HAL, taking its consolidated order book to ₹4,708 crore.
Management expects another ₹1,200 crore of order inflows in FY27 and is targeting an order base of ₹8,000–10,000 crore over the coming years, excluding the main QRSAM order.

During the quarter, the company showcased three in-house products a complete counter-drone system, bird detection radar and low-level lightweight radar opening additional opportunities beyond its existing order book.
Management estimates an opportunity of ₹200–300 crore for bird detection radar over the next 2–3 years and around ₹1,000 crore for the lightweight radar over five years.
